# Mahamodul Hasan Moon

> Mahamodul Hasan Moon is a freelance full-stack developer and DevOps engineer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He has 6+ years of experience building web applications with Next.js and Node.js and deploying them with Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Nginx and AWS. He founded the agency Brainicsoft Digital in 2023 and works with clients internationally through Fiverr and Upwork.

## Key facts

- Name: Mahamodul Hasan Moon
- Role: Full-Stack Developer and DevOps Engineer
- Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Experience: 6+ years
- Agency: Brainicsoft Digital, founded 2023
- Services: full-stack web development, Docker and CI/CD, AWS and VPS deployment, payment gateway integration (Stripe, bKash, SSLCommerz), workflow automation, ongoing support
- Platforms: Fiverr (fiverr.com/moon_mahamodul), Upwork
- GitHub: github.com/mahamodulhasanmoon
